projection_limit: Current recent-100 window can roll off; exact original timing is derived from the preserved local-timeout observation, not inferred from an absent live entry.
source_findings: Recovery IPC invokes each async handler directly; no generic IPC request queue lock was found.
MCP uses ThreadingHTTPServer, with separate request threads; no global FIFO tool lock was found.
Before dispatch_rpc, handle_rpc resolves workspace scope, reads request task state and touches the durable hub client.
Tool performance start is recorded inside Runtime.call_tool, after those HTTP predispatch boundaries.
Task-context registry and ledger use RLocks; registry persists the complete JSON with fsync while locked; ledger connections use SQLite busy_timeout=5000.
A disconnected MCP client does not cancel the handler; later response writes suppress broken pipe.
hypotheses_not_proven: The 22.759s dispatch-to-tool-entry gap includes node/Recovery preflight, HTTP scheduling and predispatch; request-arrival clocks do not identify which boundary dominated.
Registry or ledger lock/I/O contention is plausible, but current timing and event projections do not prove the cause or duration.

canonical_ledger_observation.limit: These are run lifecycle events, not request-arrival or lock-wait instrumentation; absence does not exclude contention.

recommendation.current_eight_second_budget: One observed valid exact bootstrap entered after UNKNOWN; 8s is insufficient for this observed path.
recommendation.twenty_second_candidate: 20s remains below the observed 22.759s dispatch-to-tool-entry delay.
recommendation.thirty_second_candidate: 30s is an evidence-backed candidate with about 7s headroom for this one observed delayed bootstrap; it is not a reliability percentile or proven SLA.
recommendation.align_all_layers: Prefer one bounded absolute budget for the bind+read operation and give IPC/subprocess additional bounded preflight/return margin. Raising only the inner timeout is clipped by current 15s IPC or configured subprocess budget.
recommendation.if_retaining_per_request_budgets: Two sequential 30s requests need outer IPC/subprocess budgets above 60s plus bounded preflight and return margin; do not describe this as a 30s whole-action deadline.
recommendation.focused_validation: After an authorized source/package revision, inject a 23s pre-tool delay, verify a single bind/read succeeds within the aligned budget, and verify expiration remains UNKNOWN with no redispatch or unsupported success reconciliation.
recommendation.current_original_action: Preserve UNKNOWN and reconcile only the exact original action/attempt through supported authority; late bootstrap success cannot prove bounded file-read success.
recommendation.freeze: No source or production changes made by this audit; root continues original rejection and the new canary independently.
